title: Rainbow soap cube slicing 🌈🧼
description: The most satisfying sound ever? 🔊 Rate it 1-10 👇

scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 video, 8 seconds. A cube of soap with perfect rainbow layers sits on a black cutting board. A knife slices thin sheets off the top, the sheets curling as they fall. Style: macro close-up, studio lighting, pure black background, ultra realistic, 4k, slow motion, crisp detailed ASMR cutting and crackling sounds, no music, no voice. Audio: Soft crisp soap-cutting crunches, rhythmic and satisfying.

Vertical 9:16 video, 8 seconds. Extreme macro of the knife cutting the cube into tiny rainbow cubes that tumble into a neat pile. Style: macro close-up, studio lighting, pure black background, ultra realistic, 4k, slow motion, crisp detailed ASMR cutting and crackling sounds, no music, no voice. Audio: Fast crunchy tapping sounds as the small cubes fall.
